text:
jaime_sales: Opal Diagnostics legal sent back the security questionnaire + a hard request: 'no vendor lock-in clause' + guaranteed RTO 2h for the pilot. They're asking for an exec-level call tomorrow. Need fast triage.

nora_solutions: Do we have a standard response for no vendor-lock-in? We usually include data export + model portability language but not full unilateral termination rights.

oliver_eng: RTO 2h is doable if we run a warm standby and health-checks with automated failover. Ops needs a runbook and a short SLA addendum. That said, warm standby increases cost ~30%.

trina_security: SQ flagged: encryption at rest must be FIPS 140-2 compliant and they want an inventory of sub-processors. I can prepare a compact SQ response but will need time to list subprocessors. Also, we can offer Customer-managed KMS for the pilot.

ben_fin: If warm-standby + CMK is required, we'll exceed Opal's $6k pilot cap. What flexibility do they have? Any signal on potential ARR?

jaime_sales: They verbally indicated ~200k ARR if pilot proves out. Pilot budget locked at $6k. They're sensitive to lock-in clause because of internal procurement policy.

legal_bot: New intake created: INT-4310-OPAL. Tagging legal-team. https://redwood.co/intake/INT-4310-OPAL

ops_oncall: I can draft a minimal failover runbook and estimate provisioning time: 36 hours to stand up 2 pods with warm sync and LB. We'll need approved addendum before provisioning.

nora_solutions: Suggestion: give a portability commitment scoped to pilot only — data export + model artifacts on request within 7 days post-pilot. That addresses lock-in without broader contract changes. Thoughts?

oliver_eng: Agreed. Also propose a limited RTO-SLA for pilot: 2h RTO, 99.5% availability SLA for 30 days, with credit cap limited to pilot fees. That reduces long-term exposure.

trina_security: I'll attach SOC2 summary + subprocessors list excerpt. For FIPS requirement: our KMS in eu-west can be configured to use FIPS endpoints; need infra confirmation.

ben_fin: If we accept the limited SLA and provide CMK, we need FP sign-off on margin. I'll run numbers if legal OKs the portability language.

jaime_sales: Action items: 1) Nora/legal draft portability addendum and pilot SLA (nora/legal) 2) Ops to confirm 36h provisioning (ops_oncall) 3) Security to hand over SQ artifacts and KMS note (trina_security) 4) Finance to run promo margin calc (ben_fin) 5) Eng to confirm any model quantization to reduce footprint (oliver_eng).

deploy-bot: Intake INT-4310-OPAL updated by jaime_sales. Quote Q-4310-OPAL-1 created: https://redwood.co/quotes/Q-4310-OPAL-1

nora_solutions: I'll spin up a short addendum draft and ping legal. If we can get sign-off by EOD, ops can start provisioning tomorrow morning.

jaime_sales: Thanks — can someone join the exec call tomorrow 09:30 CET? Need legal + ops + product. I'll hold the slot tentatively.

oliver_eng: I can join 09:30 CET.

trina_security: I can join briefly for the SQ walk-through.

ben_fin: I'll join if we discuss pricing adjustments. Otherwise I'll provide a note.

jaime_sales: Great. I'll update external contact and send calendar invite once addendum draft is ready. :white_check_mark:
